# HELP dia_bridge_cardano_receiver_balance_lovelace Receiver UTxO `balanceLovelace` — ADA available to pay oracle update fees. Below the configured `alerting.receiver_balance_low_lovelace` threshold the feeder also increments `cardano_receiver_topup_warnings_total`. The `receiver_address` label carries the client's on-chain Receiver script address; `deposit_address` carries the side-deposit address operators should fund.
